text: The mitochondria is the powerhouse of the cell. It generates most of the cell's supply of ATP, used as a source of chemical energy.
Photosynthesis is the process by which green plants use sunlight to synthesize foods from carbon dioxide and water, producing oxygen as a byproduct.
Newton's first law states that an object at rest stays at rest and an object in motion stays in motion unless acted upon by an external force.
The French Revolution began in 1789 and led to the end of the monarchy in France, profoundly shaping modern democratic ideals.
Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius at sea level, but the boiling point decreases at higher altitudes due to lower atmospheric pressure.
